dct_title_s: Global Digital Elevation Map (Color Index), Terra / ASTER
dct_description_sm: The ASTER Global Digital Elevation Model (GDEM) Color Index layer shows land elevation around the world, measured in meters. On the default palette, white indicates the highest elevations, then brown, yellow and greens indicate low elevations.
A visualization from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS). Made from ASTER Global Digital Elevation Model V003 (ASTGTM, version 003, doi:10.5067/ASTER/ASTGTM.003).
